meta.print_convention: Row = one regular US equity session. Index = the session date at 16:00 America/New_York (the scheduled close) converted to UTC; on early-close sessions the market actually closes at 13:00 New York time and the label is still 16:00. Price = Alpaca daily bar close, SIP feed, adjustment=all (split-, dividend- and spin-off-adjusted). Evaluation is lag = 1 (fill at the next close).

excluded_instruments.CPER: thin trading: 47 sessions with zero trades (2016-2018) and 490 sessions with fewer than 20 trades (last 2020-01-07); under the <= 3-session forward-fill rule its 4th consecutive no-trade session (2017-07-14, inside the design window) is a missing print

meta.rates_unit: decimal per year (0.05 = 5 %), last DFF observation dated strictly before the session date
meta.carry_convention: -i_usd * days / 360 for every instrument; days = calendar days since the previous session; first row NaN
meta.research_proxy_note: US-listed ETFs are research proxies for wrappers an NL retail account can use (DESIGN v2 §0 #3)
meta.adjusted_prices_note: adjustment=all is the vendor's CURRENT back-adjustment (as of the fetch); it is a total-return style series, not a price that printed on the day — see aux['raw_close']. The vendor rounds adjusted closes to whole cents: a daily return carries up to +/- (1 cent / price) of rounding noise (see per_etf.max_rounding_error_bp_of_price).

alpaca_request.note: CPER was downloaded with the other 40 and is excluded from the lane

usd_per_eur.series: ECB EXR/D.USD.EUR.SP00.A, fixing of the same date (on or before), <= 3 sessions old

price_gaps.rule: a session with zero trades is a missing print (the vendor's flat bar is discarded); forward-fill at most 3 consecutive sessions, longer gaps stay NaN

exclusions.CPER: thin trading: 47 sessions with zero trades (2016-2018) and 490 sessions with fewer than 20 trades (last 2020-01-07); under the <= 3-session forward-fill rule its 4th consecutive no-trade session (2017-07-14, inside the design window) is a missing print
